module.name: holoscan-normals
module.description: Surface normals and planes of point clouds on the GPU, on the PointCloud message of holoscan-messages: per-point normals oriented toward a viewpoint and curvature by PCA of each point's neighborhood (an image window for organized clouds, a GPU grid k-nearest or radius search for any cloud), carried on the cloud with its colors and intensities, and multi-plane segmentation by RANSAC with normal agreement, plane after plane, with each plane's coefficients, centroid and inlier count and a per-point label image, optionally merging coplanar planes.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
